selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
惩戒
你的持续性伤害和治疗效果有几率使你的下一个审判的伤害提高50%。

 神圣
神圣震击的治疗效果和伤害提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Holy
The healing and damage of Holy Shock is increased by 15%.

 Retribution
Your damage and healing over time effects have a chance to increase the damage of your next Judgment by 50%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
惩戒
愤怒之锤和神圣风暴的爆击使目标燃烧，在4秒内额外造成([48% of Spell Power])点光辉伤害。

 神圣
神圣震击和黎明之光的爆击在4秒内为目标额外恢复([54% of Spell Power])点生命值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Retribution
Hammer of Wrath and Divine Storm critical strikes cause the target to burn for an additional (48% of Spell Power) Radiant damage over 4 sec.

 Holy
Holy Shock and Light of Dawn critical strikes cause the target to be healed for an additional (54% of Spell Power) over 4 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
惩戒
愤怒之锤和神圣风暴的爆击几率提高10%。

 神圣
神圣震击和黎明之光的爆击几率提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Retribution
Critical Strike chance of Hammer of Wrath and Divine Storm increased by 10%.

 Holy
Critical Strike chance of Holy Shock and Light of Dawn increased by 5%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
惩戒
神圣风暴和愤怒之锤有15%的几率再次施放，产生30%的效果。

 神圣
黎明之光和神圣震击有15%的几率再次施放，产生30%的效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Retribution
Divine Storm and Hammer of Wrath have a 15% chance to cast again at 30% effectiveness.

 Holy
Light of Dawn and Holy Shock have a 15% chance to cast again at 30% effectiveness.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
神圣
在复仇之怒期间，圣光灌注的触发频率提高100%。

 惩戒
施放复仇之怒后，你有100%的几率获得安瑟的祝福，并产生2点神圣能量。

复仇之怒期间，愤怒之锤会以100%的效果施放公正之剑。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Holy
Infusion of Light occurs 100% more often during Avenging Wrath.

 Retribution
You have a 100% chance to gain Blessing of An'she and generate 2 Holy Power after casting Avenging Wrath.

During Avenging Wrath, Hammer of Wrath casts Blade of Justice at 100% effectiveness.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
神圣
为一名盟友恢复([378% of Spell Power])点生命值，并在16秒内额外恢复([109.44% of Spell Power])点。

对自己施放时治疗效果提高25%。

 惩戒
为一名盟友恢复([378% of Spell Power])点生命值，并在16秒内额外恢复([109.44% of Spell Power])点。

对自己施放时治疗效果提高35%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Holy
Heals an ally for (378% of Spell Power) and an additional (109.44% of Spell Power) over 16 sec.

Healing increased by 25% when cast on self.

 Retribution
Heals an ally for (378% of Spell Power) and an additional (109.44% of Spell Power) over 16 sec.

Healing increased by 35% when cast on self.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
惩戒
施放灰烬觉醒后，你的下2个消耗神圣能量的技能会对目标施加晨光，在8秒内造成([255% of Spell Power])点光辉伤害或恢复([538.2% of Spell Power])点生命值。

晨光的伤害和治疗效果的4%会辐射给周围的盟友或敌人，目标超过5个时效果降低。

 神圣
施放神圣棱镜或圣洁鸣钟后，你的下2个消耗神圣能量的技能会对目标施加晨光，在8秒内造成([255% of Spell Power])点光辉伤害或恢复([538.2% of Spell Power])点生命值。

晨光的伤害和治疗效果的8%会辐射给周围的盟友或敌人，目标超过5个时效果降低。

晨光的治疗效果不会转移给圣光道标。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Holy
Casting Holy Prism or Divine Toll causes your next 2 Holy Power spending abilities to apply Dawnlight on your target, dealing (255% of Spell Power) Radiant damage or (538.2% of Spell Power) healing over 8 sec.

8% of Dawnlight's damage and healing radiates to nearby allies or enemies, reduced beyond 5 targets.

Dawnlight's healing does not transfer to Beacon of Light.

 Retribution
Casting Wake of Ashes causes your next 2 Holy Power spending abilities to apply Dawnlight on your target, dealing (255% of Spell Power) Radiant damage or (538.2% of Spell Power) healing over 8 sec.

4% of Dawnlight's damage and healing radiates to nearby allies or enemies, reduced beyond 5 targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
神圣
你与30码范围内的晨光产生联结，对穿越光束的敌人造成([21.6% of Spell Power])点光辉伤害，为穿越光束的盟友恢复([37.26% of Spell Power])点生命值，目标数量超过5个时效果降低。

 惩戒
你与30码范围内的晨光产生联结，对穿越光束的敌人造成([21.6% of Spell Power])点光辉伤害，为穿越光束的盟友恢复([37.26% of Spell Power])点生命值，目标数量超过8个时效果降低。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Holy
You link to your Dawnlights within 30 yds, causing (21.6% of Spell Power) Radiant damage to enemies or (37.26% of Spell Power) healing to allies that pass through the beams, reduced beyond 5 targets.

 Retribution
You link to your Dawnlights within 30 yds, causing (21.6% of Spell Power) Radiant damage to enemies or (37.26% of Spell Power) healing to allies that pass through the beams, reduced beyond 8 targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
生命值高于80%时移动速度提高5%。

生命值降至35%时，你的移动速度提高40%，持续5秒。该效果每1分钟只能触发一次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Movement speed increased by 5% while above 80% health.

When your health is brought below 35%, your movement speed is increased by 40% for 5 sec. Cannot occur more than once every 1 min.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的神圣能量消耗技能造成的伤害和治疗效果提高3%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your Holy Power spenders deal 3% additional damage and healing.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 引燃烈日灼光，使神圣能量化作晨光与太阳耀斑，为盟友治疗并灼烧周围敌人。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Ignites radiant solar fire, converting Holy Power into Dawnlight and Solar Beams to heal allies and incinerate surrounding foes.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 审判为你恢复([312% of Spell Power])点生命值，消耗的法力值降低30%。该效果产生的过量治疗的50%转移给40码内的2名盟友。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Judgment heals you for (312% of Spell Power) and its mana cost is reduced by 30%. 50% of overhealing from this effect is transferred onto 2 allies within 40 yds.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 激活光环掌握也会施放一次效果为200%的圣洁鸣钟。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Activating Aura Mastery also casts a Divine Toll at 200% effectiveness.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 激活复仇之怒，呼唤圣光强化你，使你下 [复仇十字军: 一个圣光术 / 2个圣光术]变为瞬发，且法力消耗降低50%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Activating Avenging Wrath calls upon the Light to empower you, causing your next [Avenging Crusader: Holy Light / 2 Holy Lights] to be instant cast and cost 50% less mana.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
惩戒
受到神圣风暴或圣殿骑士的裁决打击时，晨光的持续时间延长0.3秒。

2个晨光被神圣风暴击中时，其持续时间会延长0.5秒。

 神圣
晨光治疗生命值全满的盟友时，其持续时间延长0.5秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Retribution
Dawnlight's duration is increased by 0.3 sec whenever struck by Divine Storm or Templar's Verdict.

When 2 Dawnlights are struck by Divine Storm, their durations are extended by an additional 0.5 sec.

 Holy
Dawnlight's duration is increased by 0.5 sec when it heals an ally with full health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 在复仇之怒期间，晨光的爆击几率提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Dawnlight's critical strike chance is increased by 15% during Avenging Wrath.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
惩戒
急速提高2%。

 神圣
急速提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Retribution
Haste is increased by 2%.

 Holy
Haste is increased by 5%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
每8秒或当救世道标转移至一个新的受伤目标时，他们会获得一个吸收盾，可吸收接下来的0点伤害，并在15秒内使受到的伤害降低10%。

救世道标现在每5秒还会追踪你的圣光术或圣光闪现法术的目标。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Every 8 sec or when Beacon of the Savior transfers to a new injured target, they are granted an absorb shield that prevents the next 0 damage and reduces damage taken by 10% for 15 sec.

Beacon of the Savior now additionally follows the target of your Holy Light and Flash of Light spells once every 5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 救世道标额外转移10%的治疗量，并且带有救世道标的盟友从你那里获得的治疗量提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Beacon of the Savior transfers an additional 10% of the amount healed and allies with Beacon of the Savior receive 10% more healing from you.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
在战斗中，对30码内生命值最低的盟友施加救世道标，使你对他人的直接治疗也会治疗该盟友，治疗量为直接治疗量的10%。

如果救世道标的治疗使目标生命值超过最大值，或者有盟友的生命值降至50%以下，则救世道标会转移至30码内生命值最低的盟友身上。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
While in combat, apply a Beacon of the Savior to the lowest health ally within 30 yds that causes your direct healing on others to also heal that ally for 10% of the amount healed.

Beacon of the Savior transfers to the lowest health ally within 30 yds if it heals a target past maximum health or if an ally drops below 50% health.
